user.title: Connect Tigo RS485
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant is connected to the RS485 bus between the Tigo CCA and the gateway (TAP). The bus uses Tigo's own gateway protocol, not Modbus.

connection.title: Connection details
connection.description: For a network converter, it must forward the raw RS485 data unchanged (transparent mode, not Modbus gateway mode). Settings: 38400 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check your settings.

init.title: Label optimizers

error.duplicate_label: Each label can only be used once.

abort.no_optimizers: No optimizers received yet. Wait until data arrives from the bus and try again.
